theorems.name: Submission.bf_sphereCap_measure_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ H : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ)), finrank ℝ H = n + 1 → ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ ζ ∈ H, ‖ζ‖ = 1 → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (ρ ≤ 2 → ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ n) ≤ μHE[n] ({θ | θ ∈ H ∧ ‖θ‖ = 1} ∩ Metric.ball ζ ρ)) ∧ μHE[n] ({θ | θ ∈ H ∧ ‖θ‖ = 1} ∩ Metric.ball ζ ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)
